nodes.description: address public owner; privileged owner of the Owned contract, set to msg.sender in the constructor
address public newOwner; pending owner used by the two-step ownership transfer
string public symbol of the ERC20 token (POD)
string public name of the ERC20 token
uint8 public decimals of the ERC20 token
uint public _totalSupply; total minted token supply set in the constructor
mapping(address => uint) balances; token balance ledger mutated by transfer/transferFrom/constructor
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed; ERC20 allowance ledger
Owned() constructor: owner = msg.sender
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner; stages a new owner
acceptOwnership() public; requires msg.sender == newOwner and finalizes the ownership handover
safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure; checked addition c = a + b with require(c >= a)
safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure; checked subtraction c = a - b with require(b <= a)
safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure; checked multiplication c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure; checked division c = a / b with require(b > 0)
ProofOfDiligenceToken() constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and mints the whole supply to a hardcoded address
totalSupply() constant; returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with raw unchecked subtraction
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant; returns balances[tokenOwner]
transfer(address to, uint tokens) public; debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[to] using SafeMath
approve(address spender, uint tokens) public; overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender]
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) public; moves balances and decrements the allowance of msg.sender
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant; returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) public; sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract
function () public payable { revert(); }; rejects all plain ETH transfers
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) public onlyOwner; performs an external ERC20 transfer of arbitrary tokens to owner
msg.sender; externally controlled caller address used for authentication and ledger indexing
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) to an attacker-supplied contract after allowance state write
